root_cause: Production security advisor findings were fixed provider-side before the exact production migration versions were present in GitHub, and the first Trust posture scanner over-classified review surfaces as high-risk.

prevention.migration_parity: Every provider-side security DDL must be source-closed using the exact production migration version and name.
prevention.exposure_semantics: Only browser-reachable SECURITY DEFINER views/materialized views are high-risk by default; privileged RPC execute surfaces require authorization review rather than automatic vulnerability classification.
prevention.fail_closed: Provider advisor ERROR/WARN findings stay visible until provider readback is clean.

historical_replay: Supabase security advisor: 8 security_definer_view + 4 function_search_path_mutable + 1 materialized_view_in_api before hardening
shadow: Database dependency and privilege readback confirmed underlying tables were service-role only
canary: pg_stat_statements showed no recent application queries for the hardened views/cache
